units.source_text: 苗子的脸上泛起了愁容。

en.t: A look of sorrow came over Naeko's face.

units.source_text: 说不定父亲是在砍树梢枝丫的时候，

en.t: Perhaps her father, while cutting the branches at the tops of the trees,

units.source_text: 想起了被抛弃的婴儿千重子而伤心，

en.t: had remembered Chieko, the abandoned baby, and been overcome with sadness,

units.source_text: 才从一处树梢荡到另一处树梢时不慎摔下来的？

en.t: and that was why he slipped and fell while swinging from one treetop to another?

units.source_text: 那时候，苗子和千重子都还是婴儿，自然什么也不懂。

en.t: At that time, Naeko and Chieko were both still babies, so naturally they understood nothing.

units.source_text: 直到长大以后，才从村里人那里听说。

en.t: It was only after they had grown up that they heard about it from people in the village.
